description: Upload a local file to Filester and get back its share link (url), slug and file id. The file is streamed from disk, so large files are fine; the API takes up to 10 GB per file, and an account holds 10 GB in all. With an API key the file goes to your account (optionally into a folder); without one, or with guest set, it is an anonymous guest upload that can never be deleted or managed. Filester deletes a file after a stretch with no views or downloads (45 days by its API docs; its FAQ says 35). The API has no download endpoint: a file is shared as its page, https://filester.me/d/<slug>, which the url field gives.

folder.description: Folder identifier to upload into (sent as the X-Folder-ID header); needs a key

guest.description: Upload anonymously even when a key is set; a guest file cannot be deleted later

path.description: Path of a file on the machine this server runs on

name: upload_file
title: Upload a file
